name: PDF Bleed & Trim Checker
description: Inspect PDF page boxes locally to understand MediaBox, CropBox, TrimBox and BleedBox configuration before print production.
search_intent: Check whether a PDF contains useful trim and bleed box information for print preparation.
calculation: Parse PDF page-box geometry locally. Report explicit and inherited/default page boxes honestly. Compare TrimBox and BleedBox only when available; never infer that missing PDF boxes prove or disprove visible artwork bleed.
